$comment: Feature mining across surveyed image-generation prompt repositories. Each feature records provenance, value, complexity, and whether MuseForge should adopt it.

features.name: search
features.why_it_is_good: A 10k-prompt library is unusable without search.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Search over typed knowledge (case/recipe/pattern/style/technique), not just prompt text.

features.name: full_text_search
features.why_it_is_good: Users search by words that appear in prompts.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Combine with semantic intent search.

features.name: semantic_search
features.why_it_is_good: Finds prompts by meaning, not keywords.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Provider-agnostic EmbeddingProvider interface; local embeddings first.
features.notes: V0 reserves the interface; V1 implements.

features.name: category_filter
features.why_it_is_good: 13 categories make a 541-case gallery navigable.
features.user_value: Browse by what the image is for.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Category is a first-class field on every knowledge type.

features.name: style_filter
features.why_it_is_good: styles[] is an orthogonal axis to category.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Style is a first-class knowledge entity, not just a tag.

features.name: model_filter
features.why_it_is_good: Users care which model a prompt targets.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Model is a note layer, not a separate knowledge base.

features.name: prompt_copy
features.why_it_is_good: The primary action on a prompt gallery.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Copy the composed Super Prompt, not a raw case.
features.notes: CLI prints the prompt; web gallery adds copy button in V1.

features.name: prompt_remix
features.description: Remix an existing prompt into a new one.
features.why_it_is_good: Remix is the bridge from collection to creation.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Remix at the knowledge level (swap pattern/style/technique), not text level.

features.name: prompt_variables
features.why_it_is_good: A parameterized prompt is reusable across products/brands.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Variables live in Prompt DNA and recipes, not just prompt text.

features.name: prompt_templates
features.why_it_is_good: 20+ industrial templates are the repo's core value.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Templates become recipes + patterns + DNA, selected by a director.

features.name: prompt_comparison
features.description: Compare multiple prompts side by side.
features.why_it_is_good: Comparison teaches what works.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Compare alternative directions from the Creative Director.

features.name: json_prompt
features.why_it_is_good: JSON prompts are reusable, diffable, and machine-readable.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Emit both prose and JSON from the same CreativeDirection.

features.name: image_preview
features.description: Show the generated image next to the prompt.
features.why_it_is_good: The image is the proof the prompt works.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Preview images are evidence, not the product.
features.notes: V0 has no image generation; previews come from seed data only.

features.name: before_after
features.description: Show input image and output image side by side.
features.why_it_is_good: Essential for image-editing workflows.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Before/after is a recipe category, not just a display.

features.name: favorites
features.description: Save prompts to a personal list.
features.why_it_is_good: Personal curation over a large library.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Favorites feed a personal visual memory.

features.name: collections
features.why_it_is_good: Collections are the user's own taxonomy.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Collections of recipes/patterns, not just prompts.

features.name: similar_prompts
features.description: Show prompts similar to the current one.
features.why_it_is_good: Similarity is the basis of recommendation.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Similarity at the visual-intent level, not text level.

features.name: related_prompts
features.why_it_is_good: Explicit links are more reliable than similarity.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Knowledge linking (case→pattern→style→technique→recipe).

features.name: related_styles
features.description: Show styles related to a case.
features.why_it_is_good: styles[] already links cases to styles.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Style is a first-class entity with related_patterns/techniques.

features.name: tags
features.why_it_is_good: Tags capture what categories miss.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Tags + use_case + theme as three tag axes.

features.name: gallery
features.why_it_is_good: A gallery is the natural browse surface.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Gallery of patterns/recipes, not just cases.

features.name: grid
features.why_it_is_good: Grid is the standard gallery layout.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Grid + filter + sort.

features.name: model_badge
features.description: Show which model a prompt targets.
features.why_it_is_good: Model is a key filter.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Model badge + source_type badge (official/community/inferred).

features.name: multi_language
features.why_it_is_good: 16 languages reach a global audience.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Compose in the user's language; keep knowledge language-agnostic.

features.name: prompt_history
features.why_it_is_good: History enables iteration.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: History feeds personal visual memory.

features.name: contribution_workflow
features.why_it_is_good: case-template + CONTRIBUTING.md enforce quality.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Contribute knowledge (recipe/pattern), not just prompts.

features.name: attribution_display
features.description: Show author and source for each prompt.
features.why_it_is_good: Attribution is ethical and legally required.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Attribution is a schema field, not an afterthought.

features.name: source_link
features.description: Link back to the original source.
features.why_it_is_good: sourceUrl enables verification.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: source_url on every knowledge entity.

features.name: model_specific_notes
features.why_it_is_good: Model quirks matter in practice.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Model notes carry a source_type label.

features.name: prompt_editor
features.why_it_is_good: Editing is the bridge to iteration.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Edit the CreativeDirection, not just the text.

features.name: prompt_generator
features.why_it_is_good: Generation is the terminal value.
features.user_value: Turn an idea into a prompt.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Generation = director + composer, not template fill.

features.name: random_prompt
features.why_it_is_good: Serendipitous discovery.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Random pattern/style, not random prompt.

features.name: trending_prompts
features.why_it_is_good: Trending signals what's popular.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Trending patterns, not prompts.

features.name: featured_prompts
features.why_it_is_good: Featured is a quality signal.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Featured recipes/patterns, not prompts.
features.notes: freestylefly has a `featured` boolean per case.

features.name: recommendation_skill
features.description: An agent skill that recommends from the library.
features.why_it_is_good: Makes the library callable by an agent.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: MCP server exposing the service layer (see mcp-roadmap.md).

features.name: visual_director_workflow
features.description: A director workflow that plans before generating.
features.why_it_is_good: Planning (cover + inner pages + captions) before prompting.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Generalize to platform-agnostic Creative Director.
features.notes: This is MuseForge's Creative Director layer.

features.name: automated_ingestion
features.description: Automated daily sync from community sources.
features.why_it_is_good: Keeps the library fresh without manual effort.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Automated ingestion feeds the knowledge pipeline, not a raw dump.

features.name: json_style_pack
features.description: A style distilled into a reusable style.json.
features.why_it_is_good: Copy one JSON, get a style; replace variables, keep the system.
features.how_museforge_can_improve_it: Style + variables + examples as a first-class entity.
features.notes: Direct ancestor of MuseForge's Style + Prompt DNA.
